task1.title: The site of an airport now and after redevelopment
task1.prompt: The plans below show the site of an airport now and how it will look after redevelopment next year.

chartDesc.title: SOUTHWEST AIRPORT

views.name: NOW
features: DEPARTURES entrance/exit area at the bottom left
ARRIVALS entrance/exit area at the bottom right
Check-in (C) located on the left side of the Departures hall
Café located on the right side of the Departures hall
SECURITY and PASSPORT CONTROL area above Departures
PASSPORT CONTROL and CUSTOMS area above Arrivals

views.name: AFTER DEVELOPMENT
features: DEPARTURES area containing Bag drop (B), Check-in (C), and Café
ARRIVALS area containing Café, ATM ($), and Car hire
SECURITY and PASSPORT CONTROL area above Departures
PASSPORT CONTROL and CUSTOMS area above Arrivals
SHOPS added across the passage leading to the gates
Sky train replacing the walkway in the concourse
Car hire located in a new building extension to the right of Arrivals

changes: Concourse expanded from a straight shape with 8 gates (1-8) to a Y-shape with 18 gates (1-18)
Walkway in the concourse replaced by a Sky train
SHOPS added before the gates concourse
Bag drop (B) added to the Departures area
Check-in (C) relocated to the center-right of the Departures hall
Café in Departures relocated to the bottom-left corner
Café added to the top-right of the Arrivals hall
ATM ($) added to the Arrivals hall
Car hire section added in a new extension on the right side of Arrivals
Additional doors added at both DEPARTURES and ARRIVALS entrances/exits
chartDesc.overview: The airport will undergo significant expansion and modernization, doubling its gate capacity from 8 to 18 via a new Y-shaped concourse with a Sky train, adding SHOPS, and introducing multiple new facilities in both Departures and Arrivals including Bag drop, ATM, Car hire, and additional cafés.
unchanged: Overall division of the terminal into DEPARTURES (left) and ARRIVALS (right)
Location of SECURITY and PASSPORT CONTROL area above Departures
Location of PASSPORT CONTROL and CUSTOMS area above Arrivals
keyFeatures: Gate capacity expansion from 8 to 18 gates in a Y-shaped concourse layout
Replacement of the walkway with a Sky train system
Addition of SHOPS prior to concourse access
New services added: Bag drop in Departures; Café, ATM, and Car hire (in a new extension) in Arrivals
Relocation of Check-in and Café in the Departures area

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

task2.title: Making sugary products more expensive
task2.prompt:
Many manufactured food and drink products contain high levels of sugar, which causes many health problems. Sugary products should be made more expensive to encourage people to consume less sugar.

Do you agree or disagree?
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
